question: Which method achieves higher perplexity across all datasets at 3 quantization bits?
reviewer_notes: Any answer from 29 to 31 is correct
model_answer: Based on the figure, the "Uniform" method consistently achieves higher perplexity than "Ours" across all datasets (WikiText, PTB, and C4) when using 3 quantization bits. The blue bars (Uniform) are noticeably taller than the orange bars (Ours) in each of the leftmost charts.
